rationale: C24 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template. It is a recent order from the same administration using the same complete sequence: identification of multiple carriers and their represented employees, failure of Railway Labor Act adjustment, the National Mediation Board's interstate-commerce finding, a thirty-day reporting deadline, and the section 10 prohibition on changes. The child closely preserves C24's pluralized language and administrative machinery while substituting the carriers and labor organization. C23 and C07 share the same structure, but C24 is the closest recent match involving a specifically enumerated group of carriers.

shared_material.child_excerpt: WHEREAS a dispute exists between the General Managers' Association of New York representing the [enumerated railroads], carriers, and certain of their employees represented by the International Organization of Masters, Mates and Pilots, Inc., a labor organization
shared_material.parent_excerpt: WHEREAS a dispute exists between the Toledo, Lorain & Fairport Dock Company, the Toledo Lakefront Dock Company, and the Cleveland Stevedore Company, carriers, and certain of their employees represented by District 50, United Mine Workers of America, a labor organization
shared_material.explanation: Both use the same plural-carrier opening construction, with an enumerated carrier group followed by represented employees and a named labor organization.

shared_material.child_excerpt: WHEREAS this dispute has not heretofore been adjusted under the provisions of the Railway Labor Act, as amended; and WHEREAS this dispute, in the judgment of the National Mediation Board, threatens substantially to interrupt interstate commerce to a degree such as to deprive a section of the country of essential transportation service
shared_material.parent_excerpt: WHEREAS this dispute has not heretofore been adjusted under the provisions of the Railway Labor Act, as amended; and WHEREAS this dispute, in the judgment of the National Mediation Board, threatens substantially to interrupt interstate commerce to a degree such as to deprive a section of the country of essential transportation service
shared_material.explanation: The two substantive predicates are effectively verbatim and appear in the same sequence.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The board shall report its findings to the President with respect to the said dispute within thirty days from the date of this order.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The board shall report its findings to the President with respect to the said dispute within thirty days from the date of this order.

shared_material.child_excerpt: As provided by section 10 of the Railway Labor Act, as amended, from this date and for thirty days after the board has made its report to the President, no change, except by agreement, shall be made by the [enumerated carriers], or by their employees, in the conditions out of which the said dispute arose.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: As provided by section 10 of the Railway Labor Act, as amended, from this date and for thirty days after the board has made its report to the President, no change, except by agreement, shall be made by the Toledo, Lorain & Fairport Dock Company, the Toledo Lakefront Dock Company, or the Cleveland Stevedore Company, or by their employees, in the conditions out of which the said dispute arose.
shared_material.explanation: The child retains the same section 10 standstill mechanism and plural-carrier syntax, changing only the parties.
